article_title: ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 Stabilizes Model-Package and EPContext APIs, Deprecates ACL EP and Changes GatherBlockQuantized Out-of-Range Behavior

content_preview.title: ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 Stabilizes Model-Package and EPContext APIs, Deprecates ACL EP and Changes GatherBlockQuantized Out-of-Range Behavior
content_preview.summary: ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 promotes model-package and EPContext data APIs to stable, deprecates the ACL execution provider, and makes out-of-range GatherBlockQuantized indices return zeros.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

The ONNX Runtime project published version 1.31.0 on October 9, 2026. According to the [release notes on GitHub](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/v1.31.0), the release "stabilizes model-package and EPContext data APIs, improves CPU model loading and quantized MoE inference, expands device-based execution-provider selection, and strengthens model-loading and runtime reliability." The notes thank 80 human contributors and cover changes since ONNX Runtime 1.30.0.

...

editor_notes.content_quality: News piece, 675 words (range 400-1200), clear structure: Overview, Stable APIs, Behavior and compatibility changes, CPU/Apple, memory verification, CUDA plugin pairing, an explicit 'What We Don't Know' section and a short practical Analysis. Appropriate technical depth; no AI self-reference.
editor_notes.source_verification: Both sources are first-party GitHub release pages. Read source-0.html.gz (v1.31.0, 245096 bytes, HTTP 200) and source-1.html.gz (plugin-ep-cuda/v0.3.0, 224118 bytes, HTTP 200) from the snapshot directory; snapshots are complete (keyword checks hit the key phrases), so no live fallback was strictly needed, but the live release bodies were also fetched via the GitHub API (gh api releases/tags) and compared: published_at 2026-10-09T04:51:32Z confirms the 'October 9, 2026' date. source-0 confirms: the one direct quote in the article (opening sentence 'stabilizes model-package and EPContext data APIs, improves CPU model loading and quantized MoE inference, expands device-based execution-provider selection, and strengthens model-loading and runtime reliability') is verbatim; 'stabilizes' matches the notes' wording ('Stabilized the model-package C and C++ APIs', 'Promoted ... to stable C and C++ APIs'); 80 human contributors; changes since 1.30.0; EPContext callbacks across language bindings; OrtApi::GetModelPackageApi and stable OrtModelPackageApi table with experimental lookup entries removed; Compile API external initializers/EP context data to buffers enabling in-memory compilation for models larger than 2 GB; GatherBlockQuantized out-of-range indices produce zero output slices across CPU, CUDA and WebGPU for integer and floating-point quantized formats, deliberately differing from ONNX Gather error semantics; 'ACL EP is deprecated and will be removed in a future release' with --use_acl deprecation warning on source builds (no removal date or version is given, matching the article's 'What We Don't Know' statement); ONNX dependency stays at 1.22.0 after ONNX 1.23 revert, no new opset or FLOAT6; 1DS telemetry default, --use_windows_telemetry, --no_telemetry; parallelized eligible weight prepacking via intra-op thread pool; block-wise INT4/INT8 QMoE with MLAS QNBit kernels and grouped dispatch; QMoE accuracy_level (INT4 FP32 activations by default, accuracy_level=4 opts into INT8); CoreML device-based selection incl. PREFER_NPU, NPU iOS 16/macOS 13+, GPU iOS 15/macOS 12+; session.strict_workspace_verification=1 behavior and ORT-format exclusion; CUDA Plugin EP v0.3.0 and WebGPU Plugin EP v0.5.0 matched with 1.31.0 and the contrib-op schema mismatch warning. source-1 confirms: minimum core version 1.24.4 but not sufficient alone; opt-in FP16/BF16 MatMul auto-tuning via ep.cuda.enable_gemm_auto_tune=1 or ORT_CUDA_GEMM_AUTO_TUNE=1 with cuBLAS remaining default; SparsePagedAttention and DynamicSparseAttention; INT2 and mixed INT2/INT4 QMoE; matched version 1.31.0. The release notes contain no benchmark figures, as the article states. manifest suspicious_patterns is null for both sources; no injection text observed. Minor observation: both release pages carry AI-assistance disclosures ('Release highlights were prepared with AI assistance', 'This summary was drafted with AI assistance'); the article does not mention this, which is not required.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Every number, API name, option name, version, date and attribution traced to the snapshots/live notes; no discrepancies found. The article attributes all statements to 'the release notes' and refrains from adding unsupported claims. Contributor credits: only the count (80) is given and is correct; no individuals named. The statement that the CUDA EP 'ships separately' is supported by the notes ('detailed provider notes are covered by their separate plugin EP releases'). Orphan-link diff: body URLs equal article.sources exactly (2 of 2, none missing either way).
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and descriptive; the Analysis section is restrained and explicitly notes that no independent testing is cited.
editor_notes.originality: No prior ONNX Runtime article in the archive (grepped src/content/articles); new topic.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Clean, accurate News article with all claims, quote, dates and deprecation wording traceable to the two first-party release notes. APPROVE.
